items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: there was a fine little excellent banjo player around there, and we called him Baby Buster.

ctx.x: Yeah, my full name is Charles Joseph Hamilton.

Texas, that was our territory. We done good. Well, I had a chance to meet a lot of guys and get a lot of experience in music, along in that line. And a lot of the musicians I met and sang, a lot of boys from Alexander, John Duncan, Zeb, and Tav Krohn, a lot of the fellas around there. And there was a bunch of fellas there now from Elorade around there, Leonard Parker, and there was a fine little excellent banjo player around there, and we called him Baby Buster. And he was a guy, he picked a lot of solos, and he…
Who were the best banjo players here in New Orleans when you were young, when you were a kid, even before you took it up? Can you, anybody that you watched or liked?
